title: Scaffold lumamatch Python package, requirements, and ruff config
description: Create the Python package skeleton at `src/lumamatch/` alongside the existing (untouched) Node scaffold, declare dependencies, configure ruff and pytest, and create the initial STRUCTURE.md. After this task the package must be importable and `pytest` must run (collecting a single trivial import test).
acceptanceCriteria: `requirements.txt` at repo root pins numpy, pillow, pillow-heif, pytest, and ruff with `>=` minimums
`pip install -r requirements.txt` completes successfully in the venv
`ruff.toml` exists with line-length 100 and a rule selection including E, F, I, UP, B
`pytest.ini` (or `[tool.pytest.ini_options]` in a pyproject) sets `testpaths = tests` and adds `src` to the import path so `import lumamatch` works without installation
`tests/test_import.py` asserts `import lumamatch` succeeds and `__version__` is a non-empty string
`pytest` exits 0 and `ruff check src tests` reports no errors
`.agent/STRUCTURE.md` exists and documents the `src/lumamatch/` and `tests/` layout

steps.details: Create `src/lumamatch/__init__.py` containing `__version__ = "0.1.0"` and a short module docstring describing the tool. Do not import submodules here yet to keep import cost low; add re-exports in later tasks only if needed.
At repo root create `requirements.txt` with: `numpy>=2.0`, `pillow>=11.0`, `pillow-heif>=1.0`, `pytest>=8.0`, `ruff>=0.6`. One per line, no pinned exact versions.

Run `python3 -m venv .venv`, then `.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt`. Append `.venv/` to `.gitignore` if absent. Use `.venv/bin/python` and `.venv/bin/pytest` for all subsequent commands in this and later tasks.

Create `ruff.toml` at repo root with `line-length = 100`, `[lint] select = ["E", "F", "I", "UP", "B"]`, and `exclude = [".venv", "src/node_modules"]`. The exclude is essential — `src/` contains a large `node_modules` tree that must not be scanned.
Create `pytest.ini` at repo root with `[pytest]`, `testpaths = tests`, and `pythonpath = src`. The `pythonpath` setting (pytest 7+) makes `import lumamatch` resolve without an editable install.
Create `tests/__init__.py` (empty) and `tests/test_import.py` with a single test: `import lumamatch; assert isinstance(lumamatch.__version__, str) and lumamatch.__version__`.

steps.description: Verify the toolchain end to end
steps.details: Run `.venv/bin/pytest` (must exit 0, 1 test passed), `.venv/bin/ruff check src tests` (no errors), and `.venv/bin/ruff format --check src tests`. Fix any findings.

Create `.agent/STRUCTURE.md` listing the planned layout: `src/lumamatch/` (color.py, io_image.py, histogram.py, emd.py, tonemap.py, pipeline.py, csv_writer.py, paths.py, cli.py, __main__.py) and `tests/`. Mark files not yet created as planned. Exclude dotfiles, configs, and the unrelated Node scaffold.

technicalNotes: Do NOT touch `src/package.json`, `src/node_modules`, `src/playwright.config.ts`, or `src/vitest.config.ts` — they belong to an unrelated scaffold and must be left in place.
The ruff `exclude` for `src/node_modules` is not optional; without it ruff will attempt to lint thousands of vendored JS-adjacent files and be unusably slow.
Keep every module under 300 lines per the project code-quality standard; the planned file split in STRUCTURE.md is designed to make that automatic.
